verses.text: Cast your bread on di waters, because you go find am again after many days.
Give share to seven, yes, even to eight, because you no know wetin evil go happen for di earth.
If di clouds full of rain, dem dey empty am upon di earth. If tree fall toward di south or toward di north, for di place wey di tree fall, na there e go lie.
Di one wey dey watch di wind no go sow, and di one wey dey look di clouds no go reap.
As you no know di way of di wind, or how di bones dey grow inside di womb of woman wey carry belle, so you no know di work of God wey make everything.
For morning sow your seed, and for evening no hold your hand back, because you no know which one go prosper, dis one or dat one, or whether dem both go good alike.
Truly di light sweet, and e dey please di eyes to see di sun.
Yes, if person live many years, make im rejoice for dem all; but make im remember di days of darkness, because dem go plenty. Everything wey dey come na vanity.

Rejoice, young man, for your youth, and make your heart cheer you for di days of your youth. Waka for di ways of your heart and for di sight of your eyes; but know say for all dis God go bring you to judgment.
So remove vexation from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh, because youth and di dawn of life na vanity.
Remember now your Creator for di days of your youth, before di evil days come, and di years draw near wey you go talk say, “I no get pleasure for dem”;
before di sun, di light, di moon and di stars dark, and di clouds return after di rain;
for di day wey di keepers of di house go tremble, and di strong men go bow demselves, and di grinders cease because dem few, and dem wey dey look out through di windows dim,
and di doors for di street shut; when di sound of di grinding low, and one rise up at di voice of di bird, and all di daughters of music brought low;

yes, dem dey afraid of wetin high, and terrors dey for di way; and di almond tree bloom, and di grasshopper drag itself along, and desire fail; because man dey go im eternal home, and di mourners dey go about di streets;
before di silver cord loose, or di golden bowl break, or di pitcher break for di spring, or di wheel break for di well,
and di dust return to di earth as e be, and di spirit return to God wey give am.
“Vanity of vanities,” di Preacher talk, “everything na vanity.”
Moreover, because di Preacher wise, e still teach di people knowledge. Yes, e ponder, search out and set in order many proverbs.
Di Preacher seek to find acceptable words, and wetin dem write straight, words of truth.
Di words of di wise dey like goads, and like nails wey dem fasten firm be di words of di masters of assemblies, wey one Shepherd give.
Furthermore, my pikin, be warned say to dey make many books no get end, and plenty study na weariness of di flesh.
Dis na di end of di matter. Everything don hear: fear God, and keep im commandments, because dis na di whole duty of man.
Because God go bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether e good or evil.
